findings.description: The GameplayGate lines cited as direct sites are only membership in the IMPLEMENTED set and do not check anything. The real check is BukkitExpandedGameplayListener:85-93, which E1 also cites.
The ender-pearl teleport guard (TeleportCause.ENDER_PEARL to THROW_ENDER_PEARL) is never exercised. No row lands a pearl while the ability is locked, so this second guard is untested.

The probe reports the tested ability as null ("THROW_*": null) in every state line, so the server log never shows the lock state of this ability. Locked status follows only from count < threshold, which I confirmed against the raw config, and from the client overlay in rows.jsonl.

The client-mod path is stored with its Cyrillic folder name mojibake-encoded (UTF-8 bytes read as cp1251), so a third party cannot open it as written. I located the real file and its hash matches. This is a record defect only.
